_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. Values here are overridden by environment variables.
_host_note: Interface the API binds to. Loopback by default; the admin surface (model downloads, quant jobs, filesystem pickers) is a local tool. Set to 0.0.0.0 to expose on the network -- then admin endpoints refuse non-local clients unless adminToken is set.
_adminToken_note: Bearer token for the admin endpoints (send Authorization: Bearer <token>). Empty = admin works from localhost only. Required for remote admin use; also honored from CPI_ADMIN_TOKEN.
_inferBin_note: Leave empty to auto-detect: build/Release/cpi.exe on Windows, build/cpi on Linux/macOS. Set explicitly if the binary is elsewhere.
